entries.subject: DAMIT 4394: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-4394.txt. Model 4394, version 2019-12-03, pole (318°, -47°), period 3.603957 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 5.1 ±0.2 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.
